{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2283_Objection1",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_MemberWithoutKey_DoesNotThrow()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial struct ItemWithoutKey<T>\n                {\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct RecordItemWithoutKey<T>\n                {\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public ItemWithoutKey<int> StructMember { get; init; }\n\n                    [Key(2)]\n                    public RecordItemWithoutKey<string> RecordStructMember { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_BothStringAndIntKeyNull_DoesNotThrow()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial struct ItemWithNullKey<T>\n                {\n                    [Key((string)null)]\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct RecordItemWithNullKey<T>\n                {\n                    [Key((string)null)]\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public ItemWithNullKey<int> StructMember { get; init; }\n\n                    [Key(2)]\n                    public RecordItemWithNullKey<string> RecordStructMember { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(string libSource, string appSource)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> netReferences = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = netReferences.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        var parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = libCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\");\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\");\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        var generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToList();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n        Assert.Contains(generatedSources, s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d => Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource, $\"Unexpected non-source diagnostic: {d}\"));\n    }\n}\n"
}
